Intercom, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: the design layer intercom.com declares on :root inside Tailwind v4's @layer theme — the warm neutral ramp, the blueprint blues, the product accents, the responsive --text-* scale, the radius/container/z-index geometry and the --ease-* curves — plus the unlayered --button-* state matrix and the scoped palettes of .theme-light (nav roles), .brand-i2y4 (the campaign palette), .intercom-legacy (the older help/changelog surface) and [data-media-player]. The site paints one theme, body.theme-light, so there is no dark set. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from the public, signed-out www.intercom.com in headless Chromium. Saans, SaansMono, Serrif, MediumLL, IvoryLL and DmMono are Intercom's own faces and are not loaded here: the sans falls back to the system face, the mono to ui-monospace, the serif to a book serif.

Colour roles

The semantic layer the package names from the painted chrome: background for grounds (cream page, chalk hover, canvas fill, white cards, the off-white field), text for inks, border for the clay/subtle/field rules, accent for the product colours, nav for the .theme-light nav roles, action for the --button-* state matrix, badge and field for the small pieces. Every role resolves to a core palette token or a measured value.

Palettes

The declared families. neutral is the warm ramp (cream, chalk, canvas, linen, clay, the grays, off-black, navy); blue is the blueprint ramp plus the brand and helpdesk blues; accent is the product colours (fin orange, sales, ecom, operator, voice); support the Tailwind support hues; legacy the older .intercom-legacy palette; nav the .theme-light nav set.

Typography

Saans everywhere on the marketing site, SaansMono for eyebrow labels and data, Serrif declared for campaign sections (unloaded on the captured pages), the MediumLL/IvoryLL/DmMono stack under .intercom-legacy. The scale is the declared --text-{style}-{breakpoint} set: heading-1 to heading-6, callout, body-xl/lg/base, label-lg and button-lg/sm across mobile, tablet, small-desktop and desktop — every step at regular weight with tight negative tracking on the headings.

Geometry

The declared shape and container scales: a Tailwind --radius-* ramp (the site mostly uses 2px on fields and badges, 4px on buttons, 6px on nav rows, 14px on cards), --spacing at 4px, --container-* max-widths, blurs and the --z-index-* layers.

Radius

Containers

Elevation

Almost flat: the marketing surface relies on hairline borders (black at 6-12%) rather than shadows. The one declared shadow is the legacy nav menu's drop. The fields' rings are borders, not shadows.

Motion

The declared --ease-* scale (the full Robert Penner set as cubic beziers, plus the site's default --default-transition-duration 150 ms on --default-transition-timing-function), and under motion.* what the probe actually measured on the pages: 150 ms colour fills on buttons and nav rows, longer transforms on menus. Click a track to play it on its own curve.

Layout

A 34 px promo banner over a 74 px nav bar (the shared header measures 108 tall at 1440), then full-bleed marketing sections whose content columns centre at about 1170 px, and the footer. On a phone the nav collapses to the wordmark plus the menu button.
